company.name: Valor Water Analytics
company.shortDescription: Valor Water Analytics has developed customized financial data and dashboard tools for water utilities and businesses.
company.description:
Valor Water Analytics has developed customized financial data and dashboard tools for water utilities and businesses. The company’s software  including a hidden revenue locator, leak detector, and cutoff analyzer — helps utilities understand water usage patterns and opportunities for conservation.

It was founded in 2013 and headquartered in San Francisco, California.

aiResearchSummary.text: Valor Water Analytics is focused on developing systems and methods for detecting and reporting anomalies in utility meters. Their research involves obtaining utility data from a repository and using anomaly-detecting modules to identify utility anomalies and their locations. This aligns with their goal of providing customized financial data and dashboard tools for water utilities, enhancing the accuracy and efficiency of utility management.
